entities.summary: Abdul Qasim Mohammad Badruddoza Chowdhury was a Bangladeshi politician who served as the president of Bangladesh from 14 November 2001 until his dismissal on 21 June 2002. He was the founding secretary-general of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP).
